title: Intro Diving & Snorkeling Adventure - Sharm El Sheikh
overview: Discover the breathtaking underwater world of the Red Sea, one of the best diving locations in the world! Whether you're a first-time diver or just looking to refresh your skills, this trip offers an unforgettable experience.

stops.name: Hotel Pickup
stops.description: Pickup from your hotel and transfer to the sea dock.

stops.name: Sailing to Coral Reef Area
stops.description: Board the boat and head to the first stop.

stops.name: Intro Dive
stops.description: A professional dive master will guide you one-on-one for your first diving experience.

stops.name: Snorkeling Stops
stops.description: Enjoy two snorkeling locations with colorful coral reefs and marine life.

stops.name: Lunch on Board
stops.description: Relish a buffet lunch with soft drinks, tea, and coffee.

stops.name: Return to Hotel
stops.description: Arrive back at your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh by 5:00 PM.

includes: All transfers by an air-conditioned van
Unlimited water, soft drinks, tea & coffee
excludes: Photos taken by the cameraman (optional purchase)
extra_tips: You can add an extra diving stop for an additional charge.
Diving equipment is included, but snorkeling equipment is not.
Each dive is done individually with a personal dive master.
If you send us a copy of your passport, you don’t need to bring it on the trip.
